doc: n5-look alley set dressing and waves (features/alley): rects are [x, y, w, h] in metres from the arena hub (the rect's top-left). roofs = the buildings either side seen from straight above (AlleyRoofs: tar roof, brick lip and coping on the alley face, AC boxes, vents); cracks/stains/drains/puddles = the asphalt; cans = trash cans; fences = the chain-link mesh drawn over the station's thin wall; escapes = fire escapes over the cast. waves = the alley's ArenaPit rule (both ends: spawns north and south). bags = decor-only bag piles (no collision); litter = flat cardboard and paper [x, y, w, h, degrees]; tones = fills (see tones.doc). grime = lane grime (iteration 10, r2_a6): count soft dark blotches hash-placed over the lane rect [x, y, w, h] (default the alley area; the visible lane between the roofs) (size_m diameter range, tone with alpha, seed) and a dirt band edge_m wide at alpha edge_a along both wall feet (0: the print bands the soft band into a hard grey strip that reads as a cast shadow, which the owner banned), wall_bias (1 = blotches uniform across the lane, < 1 crowds them toward the wall feet); count 0 + edge_m 0 = before.

print.doc: n5-look iteration 21 (toward r2_a6's mid concrete): look_d4 world uniforms the alley sets for its own floor (core/render/look_zone.gd), weight 1 while the camera's focus is on the alley floor, fading out over fade_m metres outside it. wash_lo 0.30 -> 0.6: the light-wash fill (the alley floor) prints a mid warm grey, under look_d5's grime gate so the cracks and splats stay. Empty world or --alley-print=off = the before (pale paper floor); the city and the other stations never see it.

tones.doc: n5-look iteration 7 (toward r2_a6: a light concrete lane between dark brick): ground and roof fills, the brick lip width in m, the puddle fill ("" = the city puddle decal), the oil-stain alpha and the dumpster tint. Before (iteration 3): asphalt #6F6964, tar #C9AB8A, brick #A4664A, mortar #17131B8C, lip_m 0.95, puddle "", stain_a 0.8, dumpster #FFFFFF. Iteration 21: dumpster_lid + dumpster_body draw r2_a6's ribbed lidded bin (AlleyProps.dumpster: a dark ribbed lid over a green-grey front face toward the lane); dumpster_lid "" = the tinted city art before. bag_dark / bag_pale / bag_pale_every: the sack fills (every Nth sack of a pile pale); before #2E2833 / #C9BCA4 / 3 (the dark sacks printed as solid ink blobs).
